map.两门课若「星期相同」且节次区间交叉（a.start<b.end 且 b.star: If two classes fall on the same weekday and their period ranges overlap (a.start<b.end and b.start<a.end), they are flagged as a time conflict; on top of the time overlap the tool also compares teacher and classroom to record teacher conflicts and classroom conflicts separately. The tool only detects time and resource conflicts and says nothing about whether the course arrangement is reasonable.
map.能检测跨周或单双周冲突吗？: Can it detect conflicts across weeks or between single and alternate weeks?
map.当前按固定星期+节次比对，未区分单双周/隔周课；若课程含单双周安排，需把冲突周次: Comparison is currently done by fixed weekday plus period, without distinguishing single/alternate weeks. If a timetable contains single-week or alternate-week arrangements, list the conflicting week parities before comparing, or mark the week parity in the input so nothing is missed. The result is a reference for a first scheduling pass only.

map.排课前预检：每行录入「课程,教师,教室,星期,起止节次[,班级[,起始周[,结束: Pre-scheduling check: enter “course, teacher, room, weekday, start-end periods [, class [, start week [, end week [, parity]]]]” per line; first check whether two courses truly coincide by weekday + period + week, then detect repeated occupancy of the same teacher, room or class. Courses with different week ranges or odd/even parity are not falsely flagged.
map.冲突指标不稀释：输出课程总数、冲突课程数、班级/教师/教室冲突数与“占用时段冲突: Undiluted conflict metrics: output total courses, courses in conflict, class/teacher/room conflicts, and “conflict share of occupied slots” (conflict slots ÷ actually occupied slots). The denominator is no longer 7×max period, so a sparse timetable is not diluted by empty slots.
map.算例：同班两课周次不重叠 vs 重叠: Example: same class, non-overlapping vs overlapping weeks
map.：课程A 周一1-2节、班级一班、第1-8周；课程B 同一时间、班级一班、第9-: : Course A: Monday periods 1-2, Class 1, weeks 1-8; Course B: same time, Class 1, weeks 9-16 → no week overlap, so no class conflict. If B is changed to weeks 5-12, the common weeks are 5-8 and one class conflict is reported. If A and B share a teacher but are odd/even weeks over the same range, there is no common week and no teacher conflict.
map.先看「星期相同」且节次区间交叉（a.start≤b.end 且 b.start≤: First require the same weekday and overlapping period ranges (a.start≤b.end and b.start≤a.end), then intersect the two week ranges; only if a common week and time overlap exist does it compare teacher/room/class. The tool only detects time + resource conflicts, not course reasonableness.
map.能。输入可选填班级、起始周、结束周与单双周（全/单/双）；工具先求两课周次交集（: Yes. Input may optionally include class, start week, end week and parity (all/odd/even); the tool intersects the week ranges (overlap of start/end, then filters by parity) and only reports a conflict when a common week and weekday/period overlap exist. Omitted weeks mean all weeks 1–30; omitted class means the class dimension is not checked.
